title: An open item's after list in the sprint panel never names an item that depends on it
goal: mon_sprint.follows adds a touch edge from item A to item B only when B does not depend on A (directly or through other items), so no open item's after list names an item that depends on it

run: import json,subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--json","--panel","sprint"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120);d=json.loads(p.stdout)["panels"]["sprint"]["data"];bad=[(o["id"],a) for s in d["sprints"] for o in s.get("open") or [] for a in o.get("after") or [] if o["id"] in {x["id"]:x for x in s["open"]}.get(a,{}).get("after",[])];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: SP-yjfiemha review, 2026-10-19 (and the change it proposed to ST-trhzzeku gate g2, confirmed as built with this draft carrying the change): follows adds the touch edge by order_key, not by dependencies, so on the live panel ST-uo23fwho (doing) was after ST-hur6y3hj and ST-kx6qdtkv, which depend on it. span guards the cycle and a fully serial group sums the same, so the estimate was still right there. The check reads mutual after pairs on this clone's live panel, a proxy: at planning, plant a sprint where B depends on A and both share a touch, A ranked after B.
